title: Add Badge/Achievement
content: Create badge component. Container: relative inline-block. Badge: w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-yellow-400 to-amber-600 flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg. Icon: text-white text-2xl. Locked state: grayscale filter, lock overlay icon. Tooltip: badge name and description on hover. Progress: optional ring around badge showing progress to unlock.

variants.simple: Create achievement badge display with unlock status.
variants.detailed: Create badge component. Container: relative inline-block. Badge: w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-yellow-400 to-amber-600 flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg. Icon: text-white text-2xl. Locked state: grayscale filter, lock overlay icon. Tooltip: badge name and description on hover. Progress: optional ring around badge showing progress to unlock.
variants.advanced: Create gamification badge system. Badge display: circular or shield shape, icon/image center, color scheme by category or rarity. Rarity levels: common (gray), uncommon (green), rare (blue), epic (purple), legendary (gold) with distinct styling. States: locked (grayed, question mark or lock icon), unlocked (full color, shine effect), new (notification dot, special animation). Unlock animation: confetti, glow pulse, count-up points earned. Progress badges: circular progress ring, "3/5 completed" text, current/required metrics. Badge details: modal or popover with full description, how to earn, date earned, rarity, share button. Badge grid: display all badges with locked/unlocked status, filter by category or status. Categories: activity (posted X times), social (followed by X), quality (got X likes), milestone (member for X years). Notifications: toast when badge earned, email notification option. Leaderboard: users with most badges or points. Points system: badges worth points, total point display. Share: share earned badge to social media with custom card. Accessibility: not rely on color alone for rarity, descriptive alt text, locked state in text. Tooltips: name, description, earn criteria, date earned. Display contexts: profile page, activity items ("earned a badge"), notification.
